record.question: The well-known Indian historian who died recently was
record.explanation: Answer B: Bipan Chandra. Historian Bipan Chandra died in August 2014, the recent death relevant to this January 2015 paper. The President's official condolence of 31 August 2014 identifies him and his scholarship in modern Indian history. Historical/source note: Recent relative to January 2015; R. S. Sharma died earlier, in 2011. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=109196. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
